frf.text: Tasigur, the Sultai khan, bores through a herald's account of Yala's dragon-slaying, but at breakfast an Abzan servant tasting his food dies of poison.

The rakshasa Khudal names Yala as the poisoner in exchange for the right to feed on the traitor's soul, but Tasigur finds no evidence in her mind and kills her in frustration, then learns the poison was Khudal's own and that he has robbed the rakshasa of his prize.

Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur, the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai, and without necromancy the zombies crumble and soldiers desert; when a dragon attacks, Tasigur hides, then offers Silumgar his jade throne.

At the khans' meeting at Dirgur, Tasigur has vanished after someone leaked the summit, his guards attack, and Silumgar ends up asleep on his throne while Tasigur is collared and made the dragon's trophy.
